title: elymus nodosus subsp. corsicus
intro: Elymus nodosus subsp. corsicus, commonly known as Corsican wheat grass, is a perennial grass species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Corsican wheat grass include wound healing, anti-anxiety, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Elymus nodosus subsp. corsicus may also contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions, including cardiovascular diseases and gastrointestinal disorders.
